children: Luxembourg’s current account deficit narrowed sharply to EUR 436.5 million in the second quarter of 2026 from EUR 1,482.8 million in the corresponding quarter of the previous year.
The goods account surplus widened to EUR 327.7 million from EUR 152.8 million, while the services account surplus also increased to EUR 7,684.2 million from EUR 5,172.0 million in Q2 2025.

On the other hand, the primary income deficit expanded to EUR 8,452.8 million from EUR 6,793.7 million, driven largely by wider deficits in both employee income (EUR 3,828.5 million vs EUR 3,676.7 million) and investment income (EUR 4,624.2 million vs EUR 3,116.9 million), while the secondary income deficit grew to EUR 20.1 million from EUR 13.9 million.

title: Luxembourg Current Account Deficit Narrows in Q2
